evidence: Adds `btck_witness_stack_get_items` and `WitnessStackApi::GetItems` to the C and C++ libbitcoinkernel API headers and implementations (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`, `bitcoinkernel.h`, `bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`).
rationale: Adds `btck_witness_stack_get_items` to allow external kernel callers to inspect all items of a serialized witness stack in a single O(n) pass rather than O(n^2). As stated in the description, "Reading a whole witness stack with btck_witness_stack_get_item_at is O(n^2) because each call walks the items before the one it returns"; this is a worthwhile and deferrable performance convenience for downstream consumers.
